description: The clavicle is the slender strut that braces the shoulder girdle, carrying rhythm from sternum to acromion process for graceful arm gestures.

landmarks.name: Sternal end
landmarks.desc: Medial blocky articulation that anchors to the manubrium and sets the girdle's tilt.

landmarks.name: Acromial end
landmarks.desc: Flattened lateral plate that links to the scapula and caps the shoulder roof.

landmarks.name: Lateral third
landmarks.desc: Segment that turns anteriorly, receiving deltoid pull and trapezius tension.

landmarks.name: Conoid tubercle
landmarks.desc: Posteroinferior bump where coracoclavicular ligaments tether the strut.

landmarks.name: Deltoid tubercle
landmarks.desc: Subtle ridge on the anterior border that catches light as the deltoid flares.
